traces.name: Szilvásvölgy
traces.context: Szilvásvölgyi/Őz utcai valley access and neighbouring dűlő tracks; coarse outer slope joins.

traces.name: Bakoshegy
traces.context: Kisbakos–Ködbérc–Fény utcai hillside tracks and Pecér-völgy side; inferred ridge joins, no surveyed contour.

traces.name: Baráthegy
traces.context: Baráthegy dűlő, Bakancs dűlő and Pecér dűlő slopes above Baráthegyalja; manually estimated internal outline.

traces.name: Előhegy
traces.context: Előhegy dűlő and Előhegy utca strip between northern hill paths and the forest railway/urban-edge corridor.

traces.name: Diósgyőri-lakótelep
traces.context: Diósgyőr linear housing strip along the Bartók Béla/Árpád corridor below Előhegy; small estate extent inferred from the street fabric.

traces.name: Pünkösdhegy
traces.context: Pünkösd dűlő and Pünkösdhegy dűlő side between Pereces-patak and Lyukó road valley; coarse hillside outer joins.

traces.name: Kerekhegy
traces.context: Small ridge east of Lyukóvölgyi road, local paths towards Görögszőlő; estimated ridge extent, not elevation-derived boundary.

traces.name: Hejőpark
traces.context: Panoráma/Haladás/Csemetekert housing streets below Miskolctapolcai út and west of Futó utca, bounded approximately by the Hejő channel arms.

traces.name: Mésztelep
traces.context: Mésztelep utca and Mécses/Majus1.telep local fabric east of Futó utca, north of the Hejő channel. The name point is beside the cemetery, not used as the cemetery outline.

traces.name: Benedekhegy
traces.context: Northern Benedek hillside between Külsőcsabai/Miskolctapolcai access and Benedeki pincés paths; clip to the actual mapped allotment hillside.

traces.name: Nagyszentbenedek
traces.context: Szentbenedekhegyi/Szent Márton hillside tracks and dűlő fabric north of Perzsák; clip to the actual mapped allotment hillside.

traces.name: Perzsák
traces.context: Perzsák dűlő and Szentbenedekhegyi road area, northeast of Fajdos and above Győzelem utca; inferred internal paths and ridge joins.

traces.name: Fajdos
traces.context: Fajdos dűlő/Fajdos köz above the residential streets, between Fajdos access paths and Győzelem-side slope; actual allotment outer contour retained where intersected.

traces.name: Lapocka
traces.context: Lapocka dűlő strip east of Görömbölyi/Fenyő streets, west of Tapolcai/Alma road paths; coarse hillside division.

traces.name: Mihályka
traces.context: Southern smallholder hillside east of Lapocka and above Bacsinszky András út/stream valley, around Alma utca; approximate ridge joins.

traces.name: Mexikóitelep
traces.context: Elongated Mexikóvölgy street/industrial settlement strip between Mexikóvölgy utca and the railway corridor, with coarse west/east end closures.

industrialEstimate.name: Miskolc Déli Technológiai Park
aliases: Miskolc Déli Tudományos és Technológiai Park
industrialEstimate.context: Actual northern V. számú iparterület outline plus a rough southern development sector around Doni/Gábor Dénes roads and the rail/Hejő corridors. Existing municipal text explicitly identifies the industrial and technology park names as the same place. The newer development perimeter is an estimate, not an official industrial-park property plan.
